title: Cost of the LCFs' meaning, split: the TD3+BC actor on the true LCFs beside the paper and free arms, held-out links
description: The held-out report of the truth arm chosen by exp-lcf-cost-truth-search-331: expliCCit's actor trained with TD3+BC on the true values of the seven LCFs, an oracle for neto1 v1 (alpha 2.5, 60,000 updates, training seeds 0 to 4 from exp-lcf-cost-truth-330), beside the two arms of exp-lcf-cost-td3-report-329 with the same recipe: paper (neto1 v1's seven estimates; alpha 2.5, 60,000 updates) and free (seven free latents from an encoder of neto1 v1's architecture trained by the critic's loss; alpha 2.5, 150,000 updates), training seeds 0 and 1 from exp-lcf-cost-td3-326 and 2 to 4 from exp-lcf-cost-td3-seeds-328. If the truth arm scores like the free arm, the paper arm's cost was neto1 v1's estimation error; if like the paper arm, the cost is what the seven LCFs leave out. The four campaigns repeat those of exp-lcf-cost-td3-report-329 exactly: links 100 to 399 of net2's training links (campaign seed 32), net2-train-xl links 0 to 299 (seed 33), and both again with the flow alone (seeds 34 and 35), 30 s, every policy and BBRv3 on every episode; the truth arm reads the guest's live truth. summary.md gives each configuration minus another, each averaged over its five seeds and paired by link with a 95% bootstrap interval over links, then each policy's score minus BBRv3 per campaign.
prepare: P=(); for s in 0 1 2 3 4; do F="$IN/p"; [ "$s" -ge 2 ] && F="$IN/s"; for c in lcftd-paper-a2.5-n60k lcftd-free-a2.5-n150k; do P+=(--policy "$c-s$s=$F/$c-s$s/policy.onnx"); done; P+=(--policy "lcftd-truth-a2.5-n60k-s$s=$IN/n/lcftd-truth-a2.5-n60k-s$s/policy.onnx"); done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 30 ]; for x in "${P[@]}"; do [ "$x" = --policy ] || [ -f "${x#*=}" ]; done; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec-train" --links 100:400 --seed 32 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec-unseen" --links 0:300 --seed 33 --set net2-train-xl --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec-train-alone" --links 100:400 --seed 34 --alone --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/comfort.py "$OUT/spec-unseen-alone" --links 0:300 --seed 35 --set net2-train-xl --alone --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; for k in train unseen train-alone unseen-alone; do cmp "$OUT/spec-train/aliases.json" "$OUT/spec-$k/aliases.json"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$k/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-$k"; done; cp "$OUT/spec-train/aliases.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --over-seeds; uv run python experiments/arm_versus.py "$OUT" lcftd-truth-a2.5-n60k:lcftd-paper-a2.5-n60k lcftd-free-a2.5-n150k:lcftd-truth-a2.5-n60k lcftd-free-a2.5-n150k:lcftd-paper-a2.5-n60k lcftd-truth-a2.5-n60k:bbr3 lcftd-free-a2.5-n150k:bbr3 lcftd-paper-a2.5-n60k:bbr3; { cat "$OUT/versus.md"; echo; cat "$OUT/summary.md"; } > "$OUT/summary.tmp"; mv "$OUT/summary.tmp" "$OUT/summary.md"; for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign summary "$c" > "$OUT/metrics-${c##*/c-}.json"; done
